prompt: A closer view: the near castle fills the lower left half of the frame, its two cannons big and clear on the courtyard floor, a square keep with a timber lookout, an orange roof and a red flag, small houses along its back wall; the far castle upper right across a river, smaller, clearly a different castle with a tall round keep, round towers, a long hall and a blue flag.
